name: roadsearch-web
description: Road search in the browser: the Rust core (rust/roadsearch-wasm) in a Web Worker, Leaflet in UTM

scripts.wasm: cargo build --manifest-path ../rust/Cargo.toml -p roadsearch-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/wasm ../rust/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/roadsearch_wasm.wasm
